name: Barbie and Raquelle AI Trend: You as a 3D Doll Cartoon
blurb: The Barbie and Raquelle trend is the TikTok slideshow where the top half shows a 3D cartoon doll and the bottom half shows you in the same pose.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the original pose, hand gestures, camera angle, background and clothing, and turn the ordinary selfie in the uploaded image into the classic 3D cartoon style of a 2010s computer-animated fashion-doll TV series: a glossy 3D CGI fashion doll with smooth, flawless, slightly shiny doll skin, slim doll proportions and a long slim neck, a small neat nose, big glossy almond-shaped eyes with thick long lashes and soft eyeshadow, full glossy lips, thick shiny hair sculpted into smooth glossy locks, bright saturated colors and soft, even, cinematic studio light. Same pose, same background, a bold, glamorous doll style. Make ONE vertical 9:16 picture split into two equal halves, one above the other, with a clean straight horizontal seam across the middle and no border, no gap and no frame. TOP HALF: the person from the uploaded image as that 3D cartoon fashion doll, in exactly the same pose, head tilt, hand gestures, expression, camera angle and framing as in the photo, with the same clothes, jewelry and accessories and the same background, all redrawn in the same glossy 3D cartoon look. The doll is clearly this person: the same face shape, eye color, skin tone, eyebrows, hairstyle, hair color and hair length, and any beard, moustache, glasses, piercings, tattoos and freckles. Keep the person's gender: a man becomes a male fashion doll. BOTTOM HALF: the uploaded photo itself, exactly as it is: the same real person, face, pose, clothes, background, colors and light, photorealistic, not a cartoon, not retouched. Only scale and crop it to fill the half. Both halves show the same crop of the scene, centered on the face and upper body, so the two poses line up one above the other. Exactly one doll in the top half. No logos, no brand names, no letters or initials on necklaces, clothes or walls unless the photo has them, no doll box or packaging, no text, no captions, no watermark, no third panel. In the top half the face is a 3D doll-cartoon face of this person (big glossy doll eyes and doll makeup are the style there): the identity rules below apply in full to the real person in the bottom half, and to the doll's face shape, eye color, skin tone, hair, facial hair, glasses and age.
